D/ ANTONINVS PIVS AVG ; R/ INDVLGENTIA AVGG

A Roman silver coin: denarius of Caracalla dating AD201-206. RIC no. 281. Mint: Rome. Reverse: INDVLGENTIA AVGG (around edge) IN CARTH (in exergue). Obverse: Laureate and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS PIVS AVG. Reverse: Dea Caelestis, wearing elaborate high head-dress, draped, seated facing on lion, running right near waters that seem to gush from under rock on left.
